scope: Reauthor shoulder frame, gun placements, whole palms and fixed-length arm chains together. Preserve licensed meshes, source rest/weights/UV/hierarchy and finger local curls. No runtime replacement until full visual/contact/motion/material gates pass.
design: Choose the elbow analytically on the two-sphere intersection circle to minimize deviation from the source forearm/palm neutral relationship. Camera-space elbow-height and body-side halfspaces prevent lifted or crossed elbows. Reload left palm points upward along magazine; right wrist and palm follow the grip and trigger levels. Optical sight alignment remains required, but prior artistic eye relief and hip offsets may change coherently.
limits: Numeric neutral-axis error is a source-pose metric, not an anatomical medical limit. Source scale remains provisional. Three discrete authored poses are not a continuous animation. No local finger/contact/roll parameter grid.
gates: meaningful TDD for nearest neutral elbow, fixed bone lengths, side/height constraints and invalid/unreachable cases
fresh native pose rendering and whole-arm outside views
clear grip and magazine support with natural shoulder/elbow/wrist chain
surface crossing and independent visual review before promotion
